Case 1: \(C=90^\circ\), \(c=5\). Then
\[
b=\sqrt{c^2-a^2}=\sqrt{25-16}=3,
\]
so area \(=\frac12 ab=\frac12\cdot 4\cdot 3=6\).

Case 2: \((\sin C,\cos C)=(3/5,4/5)\). By Law of Sines, \(c=3\). Also
\[
\sin B=\sin(A+C)=\frac45\cdot\frac45+\frac35\cdot\frac35=1,
\]
so \(B=90^\circ\), and area \(=\frac12 ac=\frac12\cdot4\cdot3=6\).

\[
\boxed{6}
\]
